description: The top-level keys of a slm entry in a setup file, as imswitch.imcontrol.model.SetupInfo.SLMsInfo declares them. managerProperties is described per manager under managers/. Keys the dataclass does not declare are kept but not read.

analogChannel.description: Channel for analog communication. ``null`` if the device is digital or doesn't use NI-DAQ. If an integer is specified, it will be translated to "Dev1/ao{analogChannel}".

correctionPatternsDir.description: Directory of .bmp images provided by Hamamatsu for flatness correction at various wavelengths. A combination will be chosen based on the wavelength.

digitalLine.description: Line for digital communication. ``null`` if the device is analog or doesn't use NI-DAQ. If an integer is specified, it will be translated to "Dev1/port0/line{digitalLine}".

managerProperties.description: Properties to be read by the manager. Empty when omitted.

monitorIdx.description: Index of the monitor in the system list of monitors (indexing starts at 0).

nSections.description: Numbers of sections the SLM is divided into (e.g. 2 for double-pass). If none, considered as single section.

pixelSize.description: Pixel size or pixel pitch of the SLM, in millimetres.

serial_number.description: Unique n° of the SLM head you use. ``null``/omitted if not needed (e.g. simulated SLMs).

wavelength.description: Wavelength of the laser line used with the SLM.

wavelengthTableFile.description: Name of JSON file with table of wavelength correction values to transform 2pi modulation into gray values (given my manufacturer.) File is expected to be in the same direction than `correctionPatternsDir

widgetOptions.description: Widget options just as which patterns to display

title: slm device entry (SLMsInfo)
